name: stets
description: A website builder without a dashboard. Your own AI builds your site.

interface.longDescription:
Stets builds and hosts websites, without a dashboard. You talk to the AI agent you already use, and the agent writes, builds and publishes your site through Stets.

Start a new site, or move your WordPress site over at the same addresses. Every change becomes a new version, which you can see straight away at a preview address. Nothing goes live until you say "publish". Every earlier version stays: say "go back to yesterday's version" and it comes back as the newest version.

Once it's live, ask how the site is doing: page views per day, the most-viewed pages, the websites visitors came from and their countries. No cookies.

Every site gets the whole builder for free: previews, versions, forms, statistics and search engines.

There is no sign-up form: you sign in with Google or Microsoft the first time you connect.
defaultPrompt: Make me a website for my business
Move my WordPress site to Stets
Show me my sites and their previews
